description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractFixture' used for setting up or managing data fixtures in a testing environment within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for accessing services, database interactions, and fixture data management.

classes.name: AbstractFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class for test data fixtures in the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods for managing fixture content, database interaction, and file output.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Provides an instance of TextHelperService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager instance for database operations.

methods.name: dumpFixture
methods.description: Serializes fixture content to a YAML file in the fixtures directory, with a check on the database name.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide fixture content array.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Abstract static method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the fixture filename.
